product.name: Monoprice Designed for Mobile 12ft 3.5mm Extension Cable
product.description: Extend your 3.5mm stereo audio cable using this Designed for Mobile 3.5mm Extension Cable from Monoprice!This extension cable features a male 3.5mm plug on one end and a female 3.5mm jack on the other. The Designed for Mobile cables feature ultra-thin connector heads, which are designed to fit through a phone case. Each connector is gold plated for smooth, corrosion free connections.
